startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Public Shopify store roots or direct product URLs. Collection URLs retain legacy store-wide sitemap discovery and produce a scope warning; collection filtering is not applied. Remote URL-list imports are unsupported. The bounded example discovers one product and saves at most three variant rows.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Maximum products
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Global product limit, across all stores. One product can emit multiple variant rows. Zero removes the product cap; request and sitemap budgets still apply.

proxyConfig.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfig.description: Automatic Apify proxy by default; explicit residential groups/country or custom proxy URLs are preserved. Cloud runs require a proxy. Proxies do not guarantee site access.
proxyConfig.sectionCaption: Advanced options (proxy configuration, extend output, debug mode)

checkForBanner.title: Check for Shopify on robots
checkForBanner.description: Ensure that the remote robots.txt file contains the Shopify keyword.

extendOutputFunction.title: Extend Output Function
extendOutputFunction.description: Trusted owner JavaScript, not sandboxed. Receives item, product, data, context, fns, input, customData, request and modern Apify Actor. Return object(s) or null; changes can override the default dataset contract.
extendOutputFunction.sectionDescription: You can change the output of the items for your dataset here, or add additional behavior on the scraper.

extendScraperFunction.title: Extend Scraper Function
extendScraperFunction.description: Trusted owner JavaScript hooks: SETUP, RUN, FILTER_SITEMAP_URL, PRENAVIGATION, POSTNAVIGATION, FINISHED. HTTP options are informational; SDK2 crawler/requestQueue internals are no longer exposed.

customData.title: Custom data
customData.description: Any data that you want to have available inside the Extend Output/Scraper Function

fetchHtml.title: Fetch HTML
fetchHtml.description: Additionally fetch static product HTML for context.$ in the output hook. No JavaScript execution or dynamic rendering. Uses extra requests.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent product requests; discovery stays sequential.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max request retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Crawler retry limit and blocked-session rotation limit per request. All attempts share maxTotalRequests; zero disables retries and rotations.

debugLog.title: Debug Log
debugLog.description: Enable a more verbose logging to be able to understand what's happening during the scraping

maxItems.title: maxItems
maxItems.description: Global dataset row cap; zero means no row cap. Can truncate variants of the final product.

maxTotalRequests.title: maxTotalRequests
maxTotalRequests.description: Total actual HTTP attempt budget, including discovery, redirects, crawler retries and blocked-session rotations. Exhaustion is a visible partial failure.

maxSitemapPages.title: maxSitemapPages
maxSitemapPages.description: Maximum fetched sitemap documents, independent of product/row limits.
